text: Sankyo Frontier Co., Ltd.'s securities report for the year ended 31 March 2026 (57th term) names the non-listed Kazuyuki Kosan K.K. (㈲和幸興産, a Kashiwa real-estate company) as its parent company and largest shareholder with 50.54% of the shares, and notes that Kazuyuki Kosan's voting rights are 100% owned by Kazuo Nagatsuma, president Takatsugu Nagatsuma and their close relatives.
short: Sankyo Frontier's majority owner is the unlisted Nagatsuma-family vehicle Kazuyuki Kosan (50.54%).

source.name: 三協フロンテア株式会社: 第57期 有価証券報告書 (FY2026, 大株主の状況 and 関連当事者情報 sections; filed 2026-06-18)
